scripts.mobile:add:ios: npm run mobile:web && cap add ios
scripts.mobile:add:android: npm run mobile:web && cap add android
scripts.mobile:assets: node scripts/prepare-mobile-assets.mjs && capacitor-assets generate --iosProject native/ios/App --androidProject native/android --iconBackgroundColor '#000000' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#000000' --splashBackgroundColor '#000000' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#000000'
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:web && cap sync && npm run mobile:configure && npm run mobile:assets
